test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the sentence with the appropriate use of preposition.**

options.text: The lion and the unicorn fought between the crown.
The lion and the unicorn fought for the crown.
The lion and the unicorn fought by the crown.
The lion and the unicorn fought up the crown.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'The lion and the unicorn fought for the crown.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate sentence with a correct preposition is** Option 2.**
